metadata.rules_text:
{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts upward if recent sentiment is positive (e.g., >0.25) and model is underestimating true price.",
    "Apply a downward bias correction if model consistently overestimates prices in the first 5-7 days of the forecast horizon.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if true outcome exceeds model by >10% in the first 3-5 days (indicating early overshoot).",
    "Apply mean reversion logic: if model is above 30-day moving average for 3+ consecutive days, reduce forecast by 2-5%.",
    "If sentiment is neutral (0.00) and model shows persistent upward bias, apply a 3-5% downward correction to avoid overreaction.",
    "For spikes in true price (e.g., >15% above prior day), reduce forecast peak by 10-15% to avoid over-anticipation.",
    "If true outcome is consistently 5-10% below model, consider a 5-10% upward adjustment for next forecast horizon."
  ]
}

{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Model tends to overestimate prices in the short term (1-3 days) after recent spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "Underestimates prices during sustained upward trends, particularly when sentiment remains flat or shows minimal positive bias.",
    "Overcorrects downward after sharp price increases, leading to premature troughs — adjust by adding 5-10% buffer to forecasted lows.",
    "Mean reversion is overemphasized — reduce forecast volatility in the 10-30 day horizon when sentiment is stable.",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.25), model should increase forecast by 2-5% to account for bullish momentum.",
    "When sentiment is negative (≤-0.25), model should reduce forecast by 3-7% to reflect bearish pressure.",
    "Avoid forecasting sharp upward moves in the 30-day horizon unless sentiment is strongly positive and recent price action shows breakout momentum."
  ]
}

{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Model tends to overestimate prices in the short term (1-3 days) after recent spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "Underestimates prices during early recovery phases after dips, particularly when sentiment remains flat or negative.",
    "Overreacts to recent price movements — forecasts often overshoot the true trend by 2-5% in the immediate 1-2 day horizon.",
    "Mean reversion is underemphasized — model fails to smoothly adjust toward historical averages when sentiment is stable.",
    "When sentiment is positive (even low, e.g., 0.25), model should slightly reduce forecasted peak heights to avoid over-optimism.",
    "In the 7-14 day horizon, model consistently underestimates upward momentum — should add 1-2% buffer to forecasted values.",
    "Lagging effect: model often misses the 3-5 day lag between sentiment shift and price reaction — should adjust forecasts to align with sentiment changes 2-3 days ahead."
  ]
}
